title: Longest Common Prefix of K Strings After Removal
description:
You are given an array of strings words and an integer k.
For each index i in the range [0, words.length - 1], find the length of the longest common prefix among any k strings (selected at distinct indices) from the remaining array after removing the ith element.
Return an array answer, where answer[i] is the answer for ith element. If removing the ith element leaves the array with fewer than k strings, answer[i] is 0.
Example 1:
Example 2:
Constraints:
constraints: words[i] consists of lowercase English letters.
The sum of words[i].length is smaller than or equal 105.
hints: Use a trie to store all the strings initially.
For each node in the trie, maintain the count of paths ending there.
For each arr[i], remove it from the trie and update the counts.
During evaluation, find the innermost node with at least k paths ending there.
Use a multiset or similar structure to handle updates efficiently.

    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate([]int{"same","same","same","same","same"}, 4), []int{4, 4, 4, 4, 4})
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate([]int{"hello","hell","heaven","heavy"}, 3), []int{2, 2, 2, 2})
}
